title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order 2009

sections.shortTitle: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1 OF 2009
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1
OF 2009
SALARY OF JUDGES OF SUPERIOR
COURTS ORDER, 2009
An Order
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
10th January, 2009]
No.F.2(2)/2009-Pub.,
dated 10-1-2009.--The following President's Order promulgated by the President
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas the first paragraph of the fifth
schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan relating to
the Supreme Court and High Courts provides that such higher salary other than
that specified in the said paragraph shall be paid to a Judge of the Supreme
Court or a High Court as the President may from time to time determine;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by the aforesaid paragraph the President is pleased to make the
following Order:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This order may be called the Salary of Judges of Superior
Court Order, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force with
immediate effect.

10th January, 2009]
No.F.2(2)/2009-Pub.,
dated 10-1-2009.--The following President's Order promulgated by the President
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas the first paragraph of the fifth
schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan relating to
the Supreme Court and High Courts provides that such higher salary other than
that specified in the said paragraph shall be paid to a Judge of the Supreme
Court or a High Court as the President may from time to time determine;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by the aforesaid paragraph the President is pleased to make the
following Order:--
2. Salary.--(1) The salary to be paid
per mensem to the Chief Justice of Pakistan shall be
Rs.1,99,875 and that to be paid to every other Judge
of the Supreme Court shall be Rs.1,88,813.
(2) The salary to be paid per mensem to the Chief Justice of a High Court shall be Rs.1,85,250 and that to be paid to every other Judge of a High
Court shall be Rs.1,78,125.
